description: This circular walk visits Stoke Common near the village of Stoke Poges in Berkshire. The common is located just to the north east of the village and includes a series of easy footpaths. On the common you can explore areas of birch, pine and mixed woodland, with several ponds to see as well. The area is a designated Site of Special Scientific Interest and includes some interesting flora and fauna too. The site is crossed by the Beeches Way so you could pick up this waymarked long distance trail to continue your walking.
